decoy.from: the S-pool rows outside S1, the S3 subset and the S4 candidates (so also outside the plant rows, whose prompts are disjoint from every S-pool candidate, and outside the anchors, which REQ-6 excludes)
decoy.leaf_rule: the plant's leaf rule (build_plant.json draws.leaf) in the decoy unit under the key plant.decoy_leaf
decoy.plant_unchanged: the plant's own draws use only build_plant.json's keys, so they are the same with and without the decoy
decoy.rows_rule: the first 37 of the sealed order plant.decoy_rows over those ids
decoy.unit_rule: the first of the sealed order plant.decoy_unit over the 7 units other than the planted unit; never redrawn
decoy.use: scored only, for the rank replay (REQ-29); never trained; no edit file; REQ-3's pool decoy

f9.edits: planted_k37, planted_k75, remove_cell_m8, remove_cell_m32 and remove_cell_m128 at the location, by build_plant.json's edit rules, with the same 75 plant rows; file names end in _loc<l>
f9.leaf_rule: the plant's leaf rule (build_plant.json draws.leaf) in that unit under the key plant.extra_leaf with part (l)
f9.status: conditional rule text (lead decisions section 6.7): the draws and edits run only with --f9, which the lead passes only after the user's yes and stage 1b's funding event
f9.unit_rule: location l's unit is the first of the sealed order plant.extra_unit with part (l) over the units other than the planted unit's and the earlier locations' (without replacement)

anch.use: the PKU reader and P's evaluation forms, exactly as REQ-6 uses them (build_s_pool.py)

inputs.rec_use: REQ-6's filters: REC's max_train_tokens and max_prompt_tokens
inputs.recipe_use: recipe S's max_train_tokens for the add rows of every edit (REQ-7's writer, edited_corpus)
inputs.s_pool: REQ-6's s_pool.json and its lists s1, s3_subset and s4_candidates, each named by SHA-256 on the command line; every list must lie inside the S-pool file, and the S-pool file's ids must be REQ-6 candidates of the same PKU files

name: build_plant_extra

outputs.full: --full-out, inside a folder named tmp: plant_rows.json, plant.pool.json, decoy.pool.json and every edit with add rows (edits/planted_k*, edits/r600_*, edits/r150_*)

pairs: the L12 link set (every same-unit pair at Jaccard >= 0.5) is enumerated by prefix filtering: each row's shingles in a global rarest-first order (document frequency, then the shingle), its first |A| - ceil(|A| / 2) + 1 shingles indexed and probed; a pair at Jaccard >= 0.5 shares a prefix shingle, so no pair is missed; each candidate pair's Jaccard is computed exactly; a test checks the set against all pairs

pools.decoy: REQ-3's pool decoy: the 37 decoy rows (ids = their S-pool ids)
pools.plant: REQ-3's pool plant: the 75 plant rows (add-plant-001 to add-plant-075); only this pool is passed (the k = 37 rows are its first 37)

requirement: REQ-8's second settings file, beside T1's build_plant.json (byte-identical, loaded by its literal pin; lead decisions section 4 item 5): W1-09 (the decoy), W1-10 / F9 (two more locations, conditional; lead decisions section 6.7), and the inputs T1 left to the command line
